GH20 activity on N-glycans from pretreated PSGL-1

glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B.Rd

The N-glycan fraction reported alongside the PSGL-1 GH20 enzyme screen. These measurements describe three N-glycan features with exposed N-acetylglucosamine in the pretreated glycoprotein preparation, permitting inspection of enzyme responses outside the O-glycan core panel. Supplementary Table S10B reports the three features across eight conditions.

Usage

glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B

Format

A glyexp::GlycomicSE with 3 features and 8 observations. The abundance assay is in percentage of source total glycan AUC.

Source

GlycoPOST GPST000643. Supplementary Table S10B, N-glycan rows 25-27 (media-11.xlsx). Study: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.26.714468. Repository: https://glycopost.glycosmos.org/entry/GPST000643.

Details

The protein substrate was pretreated with BT0455 sialidase and the galactosidases BT1626 and BT4241 to expose terminal N-acetylglucosamine. The eight conditions are control, BT1621, BT1627, BT3178, BT3598, BT3868, BT4394 and BT4681. There is one source column per condition; biological replicate type and expression-system species are not established by these table columns.

This object follows the workbook's explicit N-glycan classification rather than combining these features with its O-glycan section. It is not a separate set of eight biological samples inferred from that split. The source percentages are preserved without changing their denominator. Compare glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B for the complementary feature space.

The three composition labels and putative structures are encoded, including the source reduced reducing ends.

See also

glyhub_data_conventions for missing-value handling, annotations and access to original measurements and source coordinates.
